title: Routed campus ticket: OSPF area mismatch
summary: Restore the failed EDGE-B adjacency by correcting its interface area.
brief: EDGE-A and CORE-1 form a Full OSPF adjacency, but EDGE-B has no neighbor. Use the three-router topology, show ip ospf neighbor, and show ip ospf interface brief to find the incompatible area on the CORE-1 to EDGE-B link. This lab models only basic adjacency eligibility and Full state; it does not model LSAs, route exchange, DR/BDR election, timers, authentication, or traffic.
objectives: Restore a Full adjacency between CORE-1 and EDGE-B
Verify the neighbor and interface state
hints: Compare the OSPF interface area on both sides of the failing link.
A Full neighbor requires compatible interface participation and area.
Remove the wrong network-area assignment before adding the corrected one.
